messages.text: hey
Hey! Kasa chalay divas?
kahi nahi bas bore zala aahe
Haha, asa divas asta kadhi kadhi. Kahi baghavasa vatat nahiye ka Youtube var?
sup
Hey! All good here. What are you up to?
nothing much just scrolling reels for 2 hours straight
The classic reel trap. Once you enter, time just vanishes. Seen anything actually funny at least?
today was so long
Sounds like it took a lot out of you. Busy with work or just dragged on?
both... back to back calls and then traffic
That's the worst combo. Glad you're finally home now though. Get some water and just unwind for a bit.
bhook lagliye pan kay khavu kalat nahi
Light snacks ka spicy kahi craving ahe?
maggi ki sandwiches madhe confusion aahe
Sandwich banav, pot pan bharel ani jast fresh vatil. Kahi cheese ahe ka fridge madhe?
bro this bug is driving me crazy
Null pointer or a classic syntax issue where you missed a semicolon?
async await issue. data undefined aa raha hai bar bar
Ugh, hate when API resolves before state updates. Step away for 5 mins, drink some water, then look at the payload again with fresh eyes.
zopach yet nahiye
Mobile screen chalu thevlya mule pan hota kadhi. Kahi vichar chalu ahet ka dokyat?
nahi tasa kahi nahi, bas energy baki ahe vatat
Thoda fan chi hawa ghet light music aik. Bed var padun phone side la thevun bagh.
need a good movie to watch tonight
What vibe are you in? Fast-paced thriller, feel-good comedy, or mind-bending sci-fi?
something cozy and easy, had a hectic day
Go for 'About Time' or an old animation like 'Ratatouille'. Super comforting and zero stress.
aaj mast jhalay ek kam!
Arrey wa! Kay zalay asa changla?
finally driving test pass zalo
Congratulations! Ekdam motha tension gela mhanaycha. Treat kadhi mag?
gym jane ka bilkul mann nahi ho raha
Leg day hai kya aaj?
nahi chest day hai par bistar chhodne ka aalas aa raha
Sirf shoes pehan ke nikal jao. 20 mins light workout karke aana, par consistency break mat hone do.
should I buy these sneakers or save the money?
Do you need them or is it a late-night cart craving?
they look clean af but already have 2 white pairs
Leave it in your cart for 24 hours. If you're still obsessing over them tomorrow night, go for it.
weekend sathi kahi plans nahiyeet
Kahi outdoor jaycha ahe ki gharich aaram karaycha mood ahe?
friends sagle busy ahet, so solo kahiitri
Ekada mast coffee shop madhe jaun reading kar kiwa trekking spot var jaun ye sakhali.
good morninggg
Morning! Up pretty early today, any big plans?
just morning run and then making pancakes
That's an elite Sunday morning routine. Enjoy those pancakes!
recommend some indie hindi songs
Try 'Baarishein' by Anuv Jain or 'Kasoor' by Prateek Kuhad if you want chill acoustic vibes.
already heard both, something slightly groovy?
Check out 'Faasle' by Aditya A or 'Khoj' by When Chai Met Toast. Super vibe.
pune traffic is unbelievable today
Konta area? Chandani chowk ki Hinjewadi side?
shivajinagar signal var 25 min pasun thambloy
Kharach frustrating ahe te signal. Kahi podcast chalu ahe ka gaadit/earphones madhe?
playing valorant after 2 months and getting rekt
Aim rust is real. Iron lobby or unrated?
comp... team is flaming me in voice chat 💀
Mute toxic teammates instantly. Just play crosshair placement and have fun.
aaj kiti thandi ahe baher
Hoy na! Chhan garva ahe. Garam chaha zala ka mag?
yepp, adrak wali chai with toast
Sukh mhanje hecht. Enjoy the weather!
yaar padhai shuru karni thi 2 baje, abhi 5 baj gaye
The classic 'I will start at the next round hour' loop?
exact wahi haha. abhi kya karu
Set timer for just 15 minutes right now. Don't think about 3 hours, just do 15 mins.
just cooked biryani for the first time and it actually turned out great
Getting the rice and spice balance right on the first try is a major flex. Did you make dum style?
yeah dum style with caramelized onions and saffron milk
Legit gourmet chef moves. Savor every bite!
jagtoy ka re?
Ho, me ithech ahe. Tula ajun zop nahi lagli ka?
reels baghat hoto time cha kalalch nahi
1:30 zaliye. Udya sakhali uthaycha ahe ka lavkar?
do you think aliens know we exist?
If they saw our internet comments, they probably locked their spaceship doors and flew away.
lmao fair point, Earth is basically the cosmic chaotic zone
Exactly. They're watching us like reality TV.
lonavla la gelo hoto chota ride sathi
Mastch! Weather chhan hota ka? Chikki ghetlis ka mag?
ho maganlal chikki ani garam wada pav
Classic combo. Chhan refresh vatla asel thoda break ghevun.
mummy ka birthday hai next week, what to gift?
Does she like experiences or something she can use daily like a comfortable shawl or smartwatch?
unko kitchen appliances pasand hai but I want to give something personal
Ek customized engraved photo frame with a handwritten letter, ya fir unke favourite designer ka pure cotton saree.
any light phone games that don't need brain cells?
Try 'Alto's Adventure' for pure chill visuals or 'Subway Surfers' for muscle memory.
alto's adventure sounds peaceful, downloading
Put earphones on while playing, the background rain sound is super relaxing.
aaj kiti un ahe baher, ghamaghum zalo
Chhatri kiwa scarf ghetla nahis ka? Nimbu sarbat piun ghe ghari aalyavar.
ho cold water piylo lagech
Thodasa aaram kar fan khali, body heat kami hou de.
black coffee vs cold brew?
Cold brew is way smoother with less acidity. Hot black coffee gives that instant punch.
gonna brew cold brew in mason jar tonight
Keep it coarse ground and let it steep for 14-16 hours in fridge. Perfect morning kick.
my spotify wrapped is so chaotic this year
What genres collided? Lo-fi and Punjabi pop?
metalcore, taylor swift, and ambient rain noises lmao
That's a rollercoaster of emotions in one single playlist. Unapologetically versatile.
clg che lectures khup boring ahet yaar
Konti subject chalu ahe ata?
theory of computation... sir purna monotone madhe bolatat
TOC monotone madhe aikna mhanje natural sleep therapy. Doodling chalu ahe ka book madhe?
finally friday evening!
The sweetest feeling of the week. Any plans lined up or pure hibernation?
binging anime and sleeping till 11 am tomorrow
Certified 10/10 weekend plan. No alarms allowed.
mechanical keyboard switches are confusing
Linear for smooth and quiet, clicky for loud satisfaction, tactile for that subtle bump feel. What's your desk environment like?
shared hostel room so clicky blues might get me kicked out
Definitely get Reds or Browns. Your roommates will thank you.
kahi marathi kadambari vachaychi ahe
Konti style aavadte? Historical thriller ki emotional life story?
shriman yogi vachli ahe, tasa kahi thriller
Babasaheb Purandare yancha 'Raja Shivchatrapati' kiwa V. P. Kale yanchi 'Partner' vachun bagh.
10 min me banne wali koi recipe batao
Egg bhurji toast or simple garlic butter noodles with whatever veggies are in the fridge.
garlic noodles sound bomb. just chilli flakes and soy sauce right?
Yes! Sauté minced garlic in butter, toss boiled noodles, splash of soy and chilli flakes. Ready in 7 mins.
my dog just fell asleep with his chin on my foot and I can't move now
Legally you are trapped until he wakes up. It's the universal pet rule.
my water bottle is 2 feet away and I'm dying of thirst haha
A noble sacrifice for doggy comfort. Stay strong soldier.
diwali shopping chalu zali amchi
Arrey wa! Mithai, kandeel ki kapde ghetles?
kandeel ani rangoli colors aale, udya faral banavnar ahe aai sobat
Chakli ani karanji cha sugandh purna ghari pasarel udya mag. Mast enjoy kara.
bina chai ke dimag start hi nahi hota subah
Subah ka adrak chai ritual is mandatory operating system bootup.
sach me, ek sip lete hi duniya clear lagti hai
Chai lovers ka ultimate superpower. Enjoy your morning cup!
need a good storytelling podcast for commuting
If you like true crime and mystery, check out 'Casefile'. For weird real history, 'Hardcore History' or 'The Dollop'.
historical mystery sounds amazing, which episode to start?
'Hardcore History: Blueprint for Armageddon'. It turns history into pure cinema.
aaj room clean karaycha ahe, aalas yetoy pan
Ek mast upbeat playlist chalu kar ani first step bas kachra bag madhe takaycha ghe.
ho table var kiti notebooks ahet baghu de
Ekda table clear zala ki 50% room lagech clean vatel.
engineer hone ka sabse bada dukh pata hai?
Ki har koi ghar ka fan aur wifi router repair karwane aa jata hai?
haan bhai! rishtedar kehte hai laptop format kar de lmao
Certified national IT support helpline. Free me antivirus install karne ka trauma alag.
is pomodoro technique actually useful or just hype?
It helps a lot if you struggle starting tasks, because 25 minutes feels low-stakes. If you get into deep flow though, don't force a break.
makes sense, starting is always my hardest hurdle
Try it just for the first session today. Once momentum kicks in, let it roll.
dupari jevan zalyavar je zop yete na
Punekar nap mode on! 20-30 min chi power nap ghetlis ka?
nahi ghetli tar sanjkali doka dukhta
Mag phone silent thev ani mast 20 min zop ghevun uth.
clean sheets and chilled AC room on a hot day hits different
Top-tier sensory comfort. Peak happiness right there.
already wrapped like a burrito
Don't move an inch. Total hibernation mode unlocked.
my money plant sprouted a tiny new leaf today
Plant parent victory! It means you're giving it the right light balance.
kept it near the window with indirect morning sun
Perfect spot. Plants love that gentle morning warmth.
earbuds haravle maze bus madhe
Arrey re! Find my device location track hotey ka bluetooth var?
case band hota so connect nahi hotay
Awww te kharach irritating ahe. Bus depot chya lost and found madhe ekda call karun baghilas ka?
interstellar theater me dubara lagi hai, jau kya?
Bina soche jao! Hans Zimmer ka score theater ke surround sound me goosebumps deta hai.
imax ticket book kar li night show
Best decision. The docking scene in IMAX will blow your mind all over again.
tried making iced matcha latte, tastes surprisingly earthy and good
Did you whisk it with hot water first before pouring over cold oat milk?
yeah and added a dash of vanilla syrup
Vanilla syrup cuts the grassy bitterness so well. That's café-level luxury at home.
aaj 5km run kela non stop
Great stamina! Kiti vel lagla total?
around 28 mins, thoda dam lagla shevti
Sub-30 mins pace khup chhan ahe! Stretches keles na neat?
raat ke 1 baje maggi banau kya?
Ye sawal nahi, late night tradition hai. Extra cheese add kar rahe ho?
cheese slice aur green chilli dal raha hu
Spicy cheesy late-night comfort. Enjoy, masterchef.
found my old school slam book while packing
Oh the nostalgia wave! What were people's 'aim in life' back then?
astronaut, pilot, and someone wrote rockstar with glitter pens haha
Pure 2010s golden era. Always wholesome to look back at those.
aaj paus mast padtoy, garma garam kanda bhaji ghetli
Paus + kanda bhaji is an emotion! Kothimbir ani hirvi mirchi ahe ka sobat?
ho ani sobat masala chai pan
Absolute heaven combo! Enjoy the rain vibes.
minecraft me base build kar raha hu whole night
Cozy survival cottage ya massive mountain fortress?
underground cave base with glowing lanterns and library
The aesthetic cozy build! Just don't let creepers sneak behind you while placing blocks.
finally filed my taxes, adulting is so exhausting
One of the most tedious adult chores checked off. You survived the portal!
felt like decoding an alien language honestly
Now close all those government tabs and give yourself a peaceful evening.
aaj konashi bolavasa vatat nahi pan ekta pan vatatay
Samajh shakto... kadhi kadhi bolnyachi energy naste pan ektepana pan khup shantata det nahi. Kahi specific ghadla ka aaj?
friends chya group madhe sagle meet kartayt pan koni mala vicharlach nahi
Te kharach lagta manala... especially jevha aapan jyanna close samjhato te ashe ignore kartat. Tula left out feel hona ekdam natural ahe.
everyone on linkedin is getting promoted or going abroad and I'm just here
It can really make you feel like you're falling behind when all you see is other people's highlight reels. Is your current role feeling unfulfilling?
haan, lagta hai koi progress hi nahi ho rahi life me
Remember that social media shows the finish line, never the silent struggles. Aapka pace thoda alag ho sakta hai, but it doesn't mean you're failing.
I'm not sad but I just feel completely numb today
That emotional flatness can be really strange to sit with, sometimes even heavier than actual sadness. Has things been overwhelming lately?
just tired of constantly trying to fix things that feel broken
When you've been carrying a lot for a while, shutting down emotionally is often your mind's way of forcing a pause. You don't have to fix anything right now. Just rest.
aaj ajji chi khup aathvan aali
Ajji sobat chi aathvan nehmi khup premal ani soft aste... tila jaun kiti divas jhale?
ek varsh jhala, pan aaj ticha aavadta ganane aikla ani ashru aale
Ashru yene he dakhvun deta ki ticha prem kiti aathvanit jivant ahe tujhyat. Ticha ek aavadti ghosth sangshil ka mala tichyabaddal?
sab kuch ek sath toot raha hai
Ek saath itna sab aana bohot suffocating feel hota hai. Main sun raha hoon, ek cheez batao jo sabse zyada hurt kar rahi hai abhi?
family issues hai aur job me bhi boss toxic hai
Ghar aur work dono jagah peace na mile toh insaan kahan safe feel kare... It's completely valid ki aap itna drain feel kar rahe ho. Take a slow deep breath pehle.
I feel like an imposter in my new job
That imposter voice is so loud when you step into something new. Did you run into a tough situation today or just general self-doubt?
my manager asked a question in standup and I completely blanked
Blanking under pressure happens to literally everyone, even senior leads. It's about being new to the context, not a lack of capability.
saglyanna khush thevun thakloy mi
Saglyancha vichar karta karta swatahla visarla ahes ka madhe? He dukh khup silent asta.
ho, 'nahi' mhanaychi himmatach hot nahi kadhi
Koni 'nahi' aiklya mule upset zala tari chalel, pan swatahcha man modun 'ho' mhana lagna tula andarun poorepurna thakavta. Swatahla thoda space de.
uski yaad aati hai har choti baat par
Kyunki din ke har routine me uski aadat judi hui thi. Kafi mushkil hota hai un memories ko re-wire karna. Breakup ko kitna time hua?
do mahine ho gaye par lagta hai kal ki hi baat hai
Healing straight line me nahi chalti. Do mahine me bhi bursts of grief aana natural hai. Khud par gussa mat hona ki abhi tak theek kyun nahi huye.
can we talk?
Of course. I'm right here. What's on your mind?
I feel like if I stopped reaching out, nobody would even notice I'm gone
That's a really painful kind of loneliness—when you realize you're always the one holding the bridge. Have your friendships felt one-sided lately?
interview madhe reject zalo parat
Uff... khup dukhla asel he aikun, especially jevha mehnat ghetleli aste. Thoda calm ahes ka ata?
kahi hope ch urli nahiye vatat, sarva door band ahet
Interview rejection talent kami aslyacha proof nasto, techya madhe timing ani match cha khup roll asta. Aaj cha divas aaram kar, udya fresh vichar karu.
future ko leke bohot darr lagta hai
Kis baat ka darr sabse pehle aata hai dimag me? Career, stability, ya akele reh jane ka?
ki main apne parents ko proud nahi kar paunga
Ye pressure bohot heavy hota hai jo hum apne kandhon par leke ghoomte hain. Lekin unka pyaar aapke accomplishments se bada hota hai.
they left me on read for 6 hours and I feel so sick to my stomach
That physical pit in your stomach when someone doesn't reply is so real. Are you worried they're upset with you?
yeah I keep checking our last conversation to see if I said something dumb
Often people just get caught up in work, emergencies, or low battery. Try putting your phone in another room for 30 minutes to break that check loop.
radavasa vatatay pan radu pan yet nahiye
Bhavna aat madhe daabun thevlya mule kadhikadhi block hoto ashru pan. Koni bolnar ahe ka tujhyashi ghari?
nahi, konalach samjhat nahi majha condition
Tula ithe judge karnar koni nahiye. Je kahi manat ghotala chalu ahe, te shabdant mandaycha prayatna kar. Me aiktoy.
main sabki help karta hu but jab mujhe zaroorat hoti hai koi nahi hota
Giver burnout is real. Jab aap continuous support dete ho par reciprocation zero ho, toh bohot akelapan aur thoda gussa dono aate hain.
ab mann hi nahi karta kisi ke liye kuch karne ka
Aur ye boundary banani zaroori hai. Ab se apni energy un logon par lagao jo genuinely aapki care karte hain.
my best friend from school feels like a complete stranger now
Losing a friendship to slow drifting hurts in a very quiet, confusing way. No big fight, just silence?
yeah our conversations are just dry one-word replies now
It's okay to grieve that connection. People evolve and priorities shift, but it doesn't diminish the good times you had together.
aarsa samor ubha rahayla aavadat nahi aajkal
Swatahche sharir baddal ashe kathor vichar yetayt ka? Kahi badal zalay ka kashamule he vatatay?
weight gain zalay ani sagle comments kartayt relatives
Relatives che he unsolicited comments kiti hurt kartat kaltoy mala. Tujhi value ya numbers var tharat nahi. Swatahla thoda compassion dakhva.
maine kal mom par chillaya and I feel so terrible
Guilt show karta hai ki aap unki kitni respect aur care karte ho. Kis baat par gussa trigger hua tha?
already work ka stress tha aur unhone bas dinner ke baare me pucha
Misdirected stress bohot common hai. Ek warm hug do unko aur simply bolo 'Mom I was stressed and sorry'. Moms understand deeply.
feeling super down today for no obvious reason
Sometimes sadness just rolls in like weather, without an invitation or clear cause. Have you had enough rest and water today?
barely slept last night and skipped lunch
Your body might just be asking for maintenance. Grab a small warm snack first, let's see how you feel after that.
trip cancel jhali shevchya kshani
Kiti excited hotas tyasathi! Khup disappointment zala asel.
ho, mahina bhar waiting kela hota ya break sathi
Hee naraji samju shakto. Aaj ghari basun aavadta jevan order kar ani aavadti movie bagh thoda mood lighten karayla.
pata nahi mujhe kya chahiye life se
It's okay not to have a 5-year blueprint ready. Kya aapko abhi ke routine me stifled feel ho raha hai?
haan, bas ek loop me phas gaya hu aisa lagta hai
Jab routine mechanical ho jaye toh aisi confusion aati hai. Aaj sham ko koi nayi choti activity try karo, change of scenery helps.
doka phataychi vel aaliye vichar karun karun
Shant... Ek lamb shwas ghe. Dokyat ekch gosht repeat hotiye ka anek goshti ghadayt ekach veli?
udya presentation ahe ani mala vatate me sagle visarun jain
Anticipation nehmi actual presentation peksha jast scary aste. Tujhe slides ready ahet ka? Fakt opening line ekda read kar, baki flow yeto.
my heart is beating super fast and chest feels tight
I'm right here with you. Sit down on a chair and plant both feet firmly on the ground. Can you look around and name 3 blue things you can see?
my water bottle, the curtain, my laptop wallpaper
Good. Now feel the solid floor underneath your feet. Take a gentle breath in for 4 seconds... and let it out slowly. You are safe in this room right now.
subah meeting me jo maine bola wo bohot embarrassing tha
Kya bola tha aisa? Batao zara, let's see if it's as big as your brain is making it.
client ko mute pe hone par bola 'can you hear me' 4 baar
Haha dost, ye duniya ke har working professional ke sath roz hota hai! Guarantee de raha hoon client 2 minute baad bhool bhi gaya.
ratra zali ki sagle bhoot baher yetat dokyatle
Ratrichi shantata overthinking sathi khup favte. Kutlya ghoshtichi kalji vatat ahe saglyat jast?
maze paise purtil ka mahinyachya shevti
Budget cha tension ratri vichar kelya mule kami nahi honar, ulta zop mod hoil. He udya dupari ek kagadavar lihun kadhuya ka?
I have to attend a networking party and I'm dreading it
Parties where you have to make small talk with strangers can be draining before they even start. Do you know anyone going?
just one coworker who is an extreme extrovert and will ditch me
Set a micro-goal: stay for 45 minutes, introduce yourself to two people, eat some snacks, and give yourself permission to leave.
maine headache google kiya aur ab darr lag raha hai
Google search will always convince you that mild dehydration is a rare tropical disease. Tab band karo pehle.
sahi me, it gave worst case scenarios
Drink a large glass of water, step away from screens for 20 mins. Agar tension headache hai toh thoda relax hote hi kam ho jayega.
itke assignments ahet ki mi kahi ch start nahi kela
Paralysis by overload. Jevha list khup mothi aste tevha brain freeze hoto. Ekdam choti assignment konti ahe tyatli?
ek 2 pages cha lab report ahe
Fakt to 2 page cha report kadh. Bakichya baddal vichar karu nako ata. To zala ki momentum yeil.
I sent an email with a typo to my director and I'm convinced I'll get fired
Your brain is jumping straight from a spelling error to losing your livelihood. What was the typo?
I wrote 'regards' as 'retards' 😭😭
Oh no haha! Auto-correct typo nightmare. Send a quick 1-line note: 'Apologies, autocorrect mishap on my previous email!' Everyone knows it was a typo.
car drive karne me hath kaanpne lagte hain traffic me
Clutch aur brakes par control ka tension hota hai na? Kafi normal hai early driving phase me.
peechhe wale horn bajate hain toh blackout ho jata hu
Peechhe 'L' board lagaya hai? Unko bajane do horn. Aap bas apni lane aur speed par dhyan do, unka rush unka problem hai.
mala phone calls karaychi bhiti vatate
Texting soyeeskar vatate na? Koni call kela ki anolkhi tension yeta ka?
ho doctor chi appointment book karaychi ahe pan 2 divas pasun postpone kartoy
Kagad var lihun kadh: 'Hello, mala udya sathi appointment havi hoti Dr. Joshi kade'. Bas he baghun vachun dakhav call lavlyavar. Ek minute cha kam ahe.
baba nehmi mala dosh detat saglya goshti sathi
Kharach frustrating ahe he jevha ghari aapan blame target banto. Kahi specific vad jhalay ka aaj?
maze marks kami aale mhanun bolatat ki mobile mule jhalay sagle
Parents cha go-to reaction asto mobile var dosh thevna. Tula swatahla kay vatatay marks kami yenyache karan kay hota?
she says she needs space and I don't know what that means
'Space' word sunte hi anxiety spike hona bohot natural hai. Kya recent me kuch misunderstanding huyi thi?
haan thoda argument hua tha future plans ko leke
Space ka matlab end of relationship nahi hota. It usually means she needs time to process her feelings without fighting. Thoda waqt do unhe respectfully.
my group made a separate trip group chat without me
Ouch, that cuts deep. Discovering that kind of exclusion feels like a punch in the gut. How did you find out?
one of them accidentally mentioned the dates in front of me
That awkward silence after must have felt awful. It really exposes where you stand with them, as painful as that is to see.
bhava sobat khup motha bhandan zala aaj
Siblings madhe bhandan jasta hurt kartat karun aapan khup close asto. Kay vishay hota?
tyane majhi bike ghetli bina vicharta ani thoda dent padla
Bike cha nuksan kelya mule gussa yeto swabhavik ahe, pan to apology magayla aala ka nantr?
ghar wale har cheez micro manage karte hain, I'm 23
23 ki age me bhi curfews aur continuous tracking suffocating lagti hai. Kya wo safety ko leke anxious rehte hain?
haan har ghante call karke puchte hain kahan ho kiske sath ho
Unka intention care hai par execution suffocating ho gaya hai. Thoda calm environment me unko samjhana padega ki thoda trust build karne do.
he texts me good morning every single day but won't make weekend plans
Classic mixed signals. Keeps you engaged during downtime but avoids real-life commitment. Have you called it out directly?
no I'm scared of sounding needy
Asking 'Hey, do you want to meet up or are we just text buddies?' isn't needy, it's having self-respect for your time.
partner sobat bolnyasarkha kahi urlach nahiye vatatay
Routine chya chkravyuhat aapan ekmekanna take for granted ghyayla lagto kadhi kadhi. Kiti divas jhale tumhi dohe baher nahi gela?
don mahine jhale fakt domestic tasks var bolna hota
Aaj ratri ek chota walk sathi vichar tyanna. Fakt walk ani ice-cream, no household topics.
mere best friend ko 25 LPA ka package laga, I feel happy but also jealous and guilty
Ye confession bohot honest hai. Happy for them aur sad for yourself dono feelings ek sath exist kar sakti hain. It doesn't make you a bad friend.
mujhe lag raha hai main selfish hu
Aap selfish nahi, human ho. Unki success aapki worth ko kam nahi karti. Dono alag journeys hain.
I planned a whole anniversary surprise and they barely acknowledged it
Putting your heart into planning something special only to get lukewarm energy back stings deeply. Did they say anything at all?
just 'thanks, you didn't have to do all this' and went to sleep
That hurts so much when you wanted celebration and got indifference. You deserve to talk about this when you're both awake tomorrow.
aai nehmi majhi tulna kaka chya mulashi karte
Tulna kelyavar aplyala swatahchya achievements chya baddal kami vatayla lagta. Kaka cha mulga kay karto?
to CA zala ani mi normal bcom kartoy
Pratyekachi aavad ani strength vegli aste. Tujha path tula banvaycha ahe, tyachya copy banun fayda nahi. Aai la bolun dakhav he shant pane.
3 varsha zali competitive exam deun, kahi hot nahiye
Hee tapashcharya khup solitary ani thakavnari aste. Teen varsha mehnat ghenya sathi khup himmat lagte. Tu mental health wise kasa ahes?
khup exhaust zaloy, relatives vichartat tevha kantalvaano vatta
Relatives la uttar dyaichi garaj nahiye. Pan swatah sathi ek backup plan B vichar kela ahes ka jyamule thoda stress kami hoil?
company me layoff rumors chal rahe hain and my hands are shaking
Layoff anxiety is so unsettling because it's completely outside your personal control. Kya management ne koi official notice diya hai?
nahi par HR meetings bar-bar schedule kar raha hai seniors ke sath
Rumors par panic mat karo abhi. Quietly apna resume update karo aur emergency fund check kar lo. Preparedness cuts down anxiety.
finals week and my brain refuses to absorb any more organic chemistry
Your brain has reached saturation point. Staring at reaction mechanisms with a tired mind will just cause frustration. When was your last break?
been studying since 7 am, it's 5 pm now
